rationale: A standard hollow vinyl bath duck is about 8 to 10 cm long and weighs tens of grams. The high bound allows for larger novelty ducks; giant inflatable ducks are excluded.
About 100 loaded cars at roughly 60 to 130 t each plus locomotives. Heavy-haul ore trains exceed the high bound and are out of scope for the default.
Mainline freight typically runs at about 40 to 120 km/h; 80 km/h (22 m/s) is a middle value.
Global average adult body mass is roughly 60 to 65 kg; the range spans regional averages. Use a lower value when children are included.
UN estimates put the mid-2020s world population at just over 8 billion.
Center-of-mass rise for an untrained adult vertical jump. Trained athletes exceed 0.6 m.
A medium banana provides about 105 kcal (about 440 kJ); small and large bananas span about 85 to 130 kcal.
A full-size school bus has a curb weight of roughly 10 to 13 t; the range spans smaller buses and fully loaded ones.
A typical passenger car has a curb weight of roughly 1.2 to 2 t; the range spans small hatchbacks and large SUVs.
Room or mild outdoor air, 20 degrees Celsius by default; the range runs from freezing to a hot day.
Air is mostly diatomic nitrogen and oxygen, so its heat capacity ratio is 7/5; the lower bound allows for humid air.
source: OpenStax University Physics Volume 2, Chapter 2 (heat capacity ratio of a diatomic ideal gas)

rationale: Mean molar mass of dry air at sea level (about 78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen, 1% argon); humid air is slightly lighter.
source: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics (composition of dry air)
